scope: Frozen working-tree integration relative to e31, excluding preexisting PROGRESS and untracked node_modules. Review is not a commit/production verification.

findings.trigger: Local monotonic age exceeds2000ms, but the overdue timer has not been dispatched and a successful write callback runs first.
findings.impact: Callback success clears pending work and cancels its overdue timer without checking total accepted age, bypassing the explicit oldest-send deadline. No retry, unbounded memory or real incident causation is established.
findings.evidence: Independent pure scheduling probe advanced monotonic clock from0 to3000 before executing stored callback without dispatching timer; failures[], writtenAudioBytes640, pending0, timers0, send_written callbackDurationMs3000.
findings.suggestedMinimalFix: In success callback, check duration(item.acceptedAt)>=LIVE_TRANSLATE_SEND_WAIT_MS before counting/observing success; fail once as oldest_send_timeout. Keep explicit callback error first cause and duplicate/closed fences. Add deterministic overdue-timer-before-dispatch success case.

resolution.change: Successful callback now validates total accepted age before updating written counters; explicit callback error retains precedence.

findings.trigger: An onSendObservation sink throws specifically while observing send_failed or transport_closed, before the pump/client calls its original failure handler.
findings.impact: Wrapper fail(CALLBACK_FAILED) closes the client and suppresses subsequent original transport failure. Diagnostic observer can replace first cause. Production bridge currently guards ordinary sink exceptions with notify, so practical exposure is narrower than the client API and no leakage/call persistence was found.
findings.evidence: Independent fake client ready, socket readyState2, onSendObservation throws only for send_failed: onError reports CALLBACK_FAILED rather than SEND_UNAVAILABLE/transport_not_open.
findings.suggestedMinimalFix: Make send-observation telemetry non-authoritative, or at least ignore observer throws for failure/close/cancel stages so they cannot replace original transport error; regression should assert original code and safe reason remain once.

resolution.change: Send-observation exceptions are isolated and cannot stop a healthy writer or replace original transport failure.

confirmedDesign: Send pump is phone-only; audition retains prior direct-send behavior. FIFO has at most one in-flight local write, pending PCM includes in-flight and is bounded64000bytes; serialized pending bytes and transport ceiling1MiB. Per-frame at most one send, no retry/reconnect/provider fallback.

Monotonic clock used for oldest wait, callbacks fenced by stopped/completed/inFlight identity; abort clears queue/inFlight/timer. session.finish enqueues after accepted audio, new append refused by finishRequested.

Phone output uses admitted per-role source VAD start offsets plus stable local tie-break, known response-created order within source, and explicit source binding. Later source text/PCM held for prior known nonempty source, current source can stream before final ASR/VADstop.

Unknown earlier response blocks later output; legal empty completed response can retire without invented source. Empty cannot satisfy missing earlier source translation. Nonempty local text without audio retains explicit failure.

Only already-arrived held output acquires5s ordering timer; ordinary silence/current source does not create a call-duration limit. New old-source output after advancing frontier fails visibly rather than replaying out of order; duplicate/tombstone fencing retained.

Bridge stop aborts both models, clears translation output, notifies translationStopped without invoking phone end. Remote original route and manual/remote hangup cleanup remain existing production paths, exercised by new in-memory lifecycle cases.

New scalar diagnostics use fixed enums, own-data-descriptor and finite/nonnegative counts; no raw audio/base64/body/error/secret/full number/providerID is logged. Local write completion explicitly differs from supplier receipt; endpoint basis remains provider_stream_estimate and actualPlaybackStartAt remains null.
